milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because when a lectern is mined it drops itself as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 lecterns (verified via inventory screenshot), so having ≥1 confirms the lectern at spawn-relative (0, 0, 3) was successfully mined. inventory_has is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted oak_sign ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 oak signs (verified via inventory screenshot), and the only way to obtain one is by crafting at the crafting table at spawn-relative (3, 0, 2) using the 6 oak planks + 1 stick from the chest at (0, 0, 4). The recipe yields 3 signs; min_count=1 is sufficient. inventory_has is the preferred rule type for craft tasks.
